deceased_data: Not covered: personal information relates to an identifiable, living natural person or existing juristic person (s. 1)
research_exemption: Further processing allowed for historical, statistical or research purposes if not published in identifiable form (s. 15(3)(e)); special information subject to s. 27
genetic_data: Not named in s. 26; health and biometric information are special personal information (university guide lists DNA) (unconfirmed)
